decision_notes: Official Parliament explains regional ordinances, regional revenue/expenditure budgets and government scrutiny including parliamentary questions and no-confidence. This is a federal-region legislature, not an ordinary municipal council. Primary evidence: https://www.parlement.brussels/le-fonctionnement/ ; https://www.parlement.brussels/les-competences/

Official site explicitly links its proceedings channel. Environment and Economic Affairs Committee recordings labelled 21 October 2026 play beyond the empty-room opening. Other chambers/rooms and Common Community Commission proceedings remain separately unvalidated.

Source conditions: The reviewed official pages designate public viewing and retain copyright notices; no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Keep the official link rather than extracting, embedding or redistributing provider media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
